in_telugu.long_meaning: Lord of the Giver of Heart

in_marathi.name: Hridhaan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Container of the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hridhaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit roots ‘hrit’ meaning heart and ‘dhan’ meaning container, Hridhaan symbolizes one who holds the heart of the universe. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu, the preserver, is also referred to as Hridaya Saraswati, the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom residing in the heart.

In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu, the preserver, is also referred to as Hridaya Saraswati, the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom residing in the heart.
